messages:
Gabe (Design): Quick design pair on the Data Controls header — a couple small but recurring issues from research: (1) security badges stack weirdly on narrow widths, (2) pills read poorly with screen readers, and (3) audit CSV and UI messages still feel "internal". Can we propose small copy + a11y tweaks?

Rina (Frontend): Yup. Current pills are `BYOK` and `EU`. On narrow screens they wrap to two lines and look like separate toggles. Also pills have low contrast on the dark header bg — failing AA for text.

Luca (PM): Customer impact: EU customers assume `EU` implies permanent storage; support tickets spike. Goal: make processing vs residency explicit without a full redesign. Also avoid breaking automations when we touch CSVs.

Omar (a11y): Accessibility notes: pills announce verbatim. Recommend aria-labels that expand abbreviations (e.g., aria-label="Customer-managed key, BYOK"). For the `30 days (default)` chip use aria-label="30 days, default" so SRs speak naturally. Tooltips must be focusable, dismissible with Esc, and not rely on hover.

Sana (Security): From security: external copy should say `Customer-managed key (BYOK)` and `Redwood managed key`. For audit events we want `key_owner=customer` vs `key_owner=redwood`. Also a short parenthetical in UI messages like `(cryptographic material handled by customer)` is helpful for SOC triage.

Gabe (Design): Proposed copy changes: header change to `Data controls & retention`; retention header inside card `Retention period` with chips `7 days`, `30 days (default)`, `90 days`, `Custom…`. Badge/pill copy: `Customer‑managed key (BYOK)` and `Processing region: United States` (mobile: `US` with tooltip). Tooltip copy for BYOK: `You supply the encryption key material. Redwood stores key references and cannot decrypt your data.`

Rina (Frontend): For contrast I'll bump text weight on the pills and use filled background tokens with 4.5:1 contrast. For stacking I'll change CSS to collapse pills into a single overflow dropdown when width < 360px. Tooltip behavior: show on hover/focus, and also expose an info button that opens a modal with the full explanation + docs link.

Luca (PM): CSV export question: some customers parse headers programmatically. We shouldn't rename machine headers. Proposal: keep existing machine headers (evt_ts, evt_type, user_email, payload) and optionally include a first metadata row `friendly_headers:` that maps friendly names. Example: `friendly_headers: Event time (ISO8601), Event type, Actor, Details`. This keeps parsers safe and helps humans.

Sana (Security): Approved. Also request that all KMS-related audit UI messages include `key_owner` in the structured metadata and the visible message include the parenthetical we discussed. Example UI message: `Key rotated — Customer-managed key (BYOK). Performed by Gabe (gabe@example.com) (cryptographic material handled by customer)`. Keep structured fields `event_type=kms.key.rotate, key_owner=customer, key_id=abc123`.

Omar (a11y): Minor: use a non-breaking hyphen in `Customer‑managed` so screen readers don't spit out awkward line breaks. Ensure the info button has aria-haspopup and aria-expanded toggles. Also test with NVDA, VoiceOver and TalkBack.

Rina (Frontend): I'll implement: pill contrast changes, overflow collapse, tooltip + info modal, and display of the humanized audit message while preserving raw JSON behind an expand chevron. I'll add a small copy map so the backend team can map structured fields to message strings.

ops-bot: Heads up: changing human-facing audit messages requires coordination. Ticket OPS-5010 created and linked. Please add migration notes for SIEM owners.

Luca (PM): Action items: Gabe finalize Figma copy with non-breaking hyphen guidance; Rina implement UI + modal + CSV friendly row opt-in; Omar QA accessibility behaviors; Sana confirm audit metadata and docs snippet; Rina/Luca to coordinate OPS-5010. Deadline: Friday COB.

Gabe (Design): Pushed final copy to Figma now: header `Data controls & retention`; retention chips `7 days`, `30 days (default)`, `90 days`, `Custom…`; pill `Customer‑managed key (BYOK)` (mobile: `Customer key`), region pill `Processing region: <region>` (append ` (default)` when applicable); tooltip text as above; CSV friendly row label `friendly_headers`. Added a note: use non‑breaking hyphen in Customer‑managed.

Sana (Security): Approved. I'll add a short blurb in the KMS docs about key access log retention and link the modal to docs.

Omar (a11y): I'll run a quick pass on the PR once it lands and post a short checklist in OPS-5010. Expect minor notes on focus order and aria-live behavior for the export flow.

Rina (Frontend): I'll open the PR today and add tests for pill contrast and keyboard flows. Will include a small feature flag for the CSV friendly row.

Gabe (Design): Thanks team :thumbsup: closing this thread when OPS-5010 has PR + docs links.
